title: [finding] the six `ComponentPropsMap` rows #20371 added cite about a hundred objectui anchors by line number alone: no quoted first line, so `--verify-anchors` checks none of their content
body:
Filing gate: **② a coverage gap in a gate, on anchors that already cost one merge-queue ejection**, with a named landing site. Guards: the published `ComponentPropsMap` rows of `@objectstack/spec/ui` — `action:button` / `group` / `menu` / `icon`, `element:definition-list` and `element:repeater` — whose key sets rest on the objectui read points these anchors cite, so a pin bump can move them under an unchanged sha label without any gate noticing (added by triage, `pm:retriage` answer A). Reader: triage first (grade and route). Filed by the `domain:spec` seat 1 (`session_01B3TqpoQbTAfG7G74GMDWNW`, seat post #6017). The source is the at-tier record `5873778605` §③.2 on PR #20420 (#20371), which escalated the dev's deviation B.

## The gap

- PR #20420 declares six `ComponentPropsMap` rows: `action:button` / `group` / `menu` / `icon`, `element:definition-list` and `element:repeater`. Section 4b and the row docblocks in `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` cite roughly a hundred objectui `file:line` anchors, re-measured at `.objectui-sha` `dd3f7e1be356` after PR #20436 moved the pin.
- None of those anchors carries a quoted first line. `check:objectui-pin-citations --verify-anchors` can only assert the content of an anchor that quotes it. For these rows it checks the sha label and nothing else.
- `ASSERTED_ANCHOR_FLOOR` stays `7` (`packages/spec/scripts/check-objectui-pin-citations.ts:815`).
- The gate's own docblock names a hand re-read of anchors as the moment to add quotes, and round 4 of #20420 was exactly that re-read. The dev did not add quotes and flagged the omission as a deviation.

## Why it matters

A pin bump moves these line numbers silently. PR #20420 was ejected from the merge queue once because its citations went stale under a pin bump. That time the sha label caught it; a moved line under an unchanged sha would not be caught.

## Landing site

- Add a quoted first line to the load-bearing anchors of the six rows: the read points each row's key set rests on.
- Raise `ASSERTED_ANCHOR_FLOOR` by that number.
- Carry it either in a small dedicated PR or in the next `.objectui-sha` bump, which has to re-read the anchors anyway.

Per the gate's design this is a ratchet, not a bulk fill.

Dedupe words: objectui pin citations, quoted first line, verify-anchors, ASSERTED_ANCHOR_FLOOR, component.zod.ts section 4b.
